CardName.DefaultText: Chicken of the Woods Spore Print

CardDescription.DefaultText: A pale spore print lifted from a ripe chicken of the woods log. Pack it into a bored log, with a spoon auger and wood shavings, to start a new log without the 10 mushrooms.

CardHelpSection.DefaultText: Found: A bonus from harvesting a ready chicken of the woods log. Uses: Inoculate a new chicken of the woods log from this single print (Inoculate from a Spore Print).
